Context: 3. Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs)

7. No carry forward of reservation.If in any recruitment year any vacancy earmarked for EWS is not filled up due to non-availability of a suitable EWS candidate, such vacancies shall not be carried forward to the next recruitment year as backlog.
8. Persons belonging to EWS selected against the quota for persons with benchmark disabilities I ex-servicemen shall be placed against the roster points earmarked for EWS.
